decisions.reason: The winner-selection rule also applies to Big Block, but its complete same-message MODIFY already records the Chainlink VRF method.
Changing how prize winners are selected does not change the one-click prize claim flow, Winners page, or claim URL.
The Chainlink VRF winner-selection rule does not alter primary-sale revenue allocations.
On-chain prize-winner selection is independent of referral-code identity and display locations.
The winner-selection method does not change the current or conditional future project branding.
Chainlink VRF is specified for prize-winner selection, not for selecting the random commission recipient when no referral code is supplied.
The candidate's same-message FAQ replacement already incorporates the complete revised FAQ containing the Chainlink VRF statement.
The prize-winner selection method does not change royalty amounts, enforcement, pool funding, or ticket generation from secondary sales.
The Chainlink VRF rule does not alter fiat minting access, dashboard authentication, or wallet requirements for rewards.
The winner-selection method does not alter which book, referral code, badges, or ticket states transfer with an NFT.
On-chain prize-winner selection does not change badge triggers, milestone thresholds, or award destination.
The Chainlink VRF prize-selection rule does not alter the amount, recipient, timing, or delivery of coded-referral commissions.
